reference.title: The screens of the app
reference.shortdesc: What each place in the bar along the bottom shows, what the top of every screen holds, and what the More list opens.

section.title: The bar along the bottom
section.p: The bar stays at the bottom of every screen. It has five places. Some show your whole tree. Others show one person, the person named in the chip that starts with .

table.title: The places in the bar and what they show

row.entry: The tree that is open, with a search box and the people you opened last.
A drawing of the person with parents, partners and children.
The things that happened in that person's life.
A list of other places, such as your trees, your notes and the colours.

section.note: If a page says Select a person or No person selected, it needs a person first. Search for someone, then open them. shows how.

section.title: The top of every screen
section.p: A back arrow takes you back one screen. Beside it, the name of the tree and the path to the screen you are on show, such as then . Below them are three buttons.

section.p: Choose to see eight places. Each one opens a screen of its own.
